title: Hyphenated IN-PROGRESS status token drift
description: Canonical machine status token is IN_PROGRESS. Hyphenated IN-PROGRESS creates inconsistent filters, counters, and transitions across pipeline and UI surfaces.
detection_method: Regex scan for IN-PROGRESS token in executable/config/view files.
remediation: Normalize status writes to IN_PROGRESS. Keep read-side compatibility mapping only where unavoidable.
